PROCESS_ROUTES.metallurgicalBehavior: Moderate work-hardening; high formability in spheroidized annealed state (Z >= 50%).
PROCESS_ROUTES.sequenceSteps: 1. Spheroidized Annealed Wire + Zn-Phosphate & Soap Lube -> 2. Cold/Warm Multi-Station Heading (Forward Extrude shank + Upset Head) -> 3. Thread Roll in Green/Soft State -> 4. Wash -> 5. Austenitize & Oil Quench + Temper -> 6. Plating + De-embrittlement Baking.
PROCESS_ROUTES.pokaYokeQualityGate: Bake at 190–220°C within 1–4 hrs post-plating if UTS >= 1000 MPa (>31 HRC) per ISO 4042 / ASTM F1940.

PROCESS_ROUTES.metallurgicalBehavior: Severe rapid strain-hardening; high galling risk; micro-cracking if cold headed heavily at room temp.
PROCESS_ROUTES.sequenceSteps: 1. Solution Annealed Wire + Oxalate / Glass-MoS2 Dual Lube -> 2. Controlled Warm Heading (Induction 650–720°C) with Carbide Dies -> 3. Solution Heat Treat (955–1100°C) -> 4. Precipitation Aging (e.g. 720°C 16h) -> 5. Post-Aging Thread Rolling -> 6. Nitric Passivation + FPI.
PROCESS_ROUTES.pokaYokeQualityGate: Roll threads AFTER aging for aerospace fatigue life (NASM/AMS). Strictly monitor warm heading temp.

PROCESS_ROUTES.metallurgicalBehavior: Gr 5 requires warm forming due to HCP crystal structure & springback; VT-16 & Gr 1 allow cold heading.
PROCESS_ROUTES.sequenceSteps: 1. Annealed Wire + Fluoride-Phosphate + MoS2 Lube -> 2. Warm Heading (650–700°C for Ti6Al4V; Cold/Warm for VT-16) -> 3. Solution Treat + Vacuum Age (STA) -> 4. Slow-Speed Thread Rolling with EP Oil -> 5. Chemical Pickling (remove alpha-case) + FPI.
PROCESS_ROUTES.pokaYokeQualityGate: Never exceed beta-transus or 750°C in open air to prevent brittle oxygen alpha-case layer.

PROCESS_ROUTES.metallurgicalBehavior: High initial yield strength in Condition A (for PH grades); magnetic & heat-treatable via Q&T or Aging.
PROCESS_ROUTES.sequenceSteps: 1. Condition A / Annealed Wire + Oxalate & Soap -> 2. Warm or Rigid Cold Heading -> 3. Thread Rolling prior to final aging/Q&T -> 4. Solution + Age (H900/H1025 for PH) or Oil Quench + Temper (for 14Kh17N2/20X13/30X13) -> 5. Passivation + Magnetic Particle / FPI.
PROCESS_ROUTES.pokaYokeQualityGate: Avoid tempering 14Kh17N2/20X13/30X13 in the 400–525°C embrittlement zone.

PROCESS_ROUTES.metallurgicalBehavior: Non-heat-treatable by quenching; strength is achieved strictly through cold-work strain hardening.
PROCESS_ROUTES.sequenceSteps: 1. Solution Annealed Wire + Oxalate + Calcium Stearate Soap -> 2. High-Rigidity Cold Heading -> 3. Direct Cold Thread Rolling (work-hardens thread roots to A2/A4-70 or 80) -> 4. Wash & Nitric Passivation.
PROCESS_ROUTES.pokaYokeQualityGate: No quench & temper HT; Exempt from hydrogen baking under standard nitric passivation.

Shop rule for austenitizing: 1 h per inch (25 mm) of section, minimum 1 h, timed from when the load reaches temperature
ISO 4042 / ASTM F1940: electroplated parts at or above 1000 MPa are baked within 4 h of plating
ALUMINIUM_SOURCES: 6061 supplier procedure: heat to 413 °C (775 °F), hold 2 – 3 h, then cool no faster than 28 °C/h (50 °F/h) to 260 °C (500 °F)

SOLUTION_SOURCES: Shop rule for solution annealing: 1 h per inch (25 mm) of section, minimum 30 min at temperature — hold only as long as needed, because austenitic grain grows the whole time
